sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球跨境基金设立第一大国、超大型跨国投资架构

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vapor Deposition of Amorphous Silicon Cesium Iodide DR Detectors

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Luxembourg (Unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate tax distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law — Napoleonic/French codified tradition (amended Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies; SCSp codified in 2013 following Anglo-Saxon limited partnership principles)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Luxembourg–United States income tax treaty (DTA, in force)
Luxembourg–People's Republic of China DTA for income and capital
EU/EEA internal market freedoms (FDI screening regime per Regulation (EU) 2019/452, implemented by the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 25 June 2023?)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Articles 103-1 to 103-5 of the Luxembourg Law of 10 August 1915 concerning Commercial Companies (as amended by the Law of 12 July 2013 introducing the Société en Commandite Spéciale), read with Articles 1831 et seq. of the Civil Code on partnership contracts.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR), accessible via the e-RCS/eJustice e-filing portal; RESA publication service for legal notices.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Déclaration d'immatriculation (registration application) filed with the RCS together with the executed partnership agreement (convention de société); subsequent publication in the Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations (RESA).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement for an SCSp; partnership capital is freely fixed in the Limited Partnership Agreement and may be contributed in cash or in kind, with capital calls at the discretion of the General Partner.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the General Partner hereby approves and adopts the Partnership Agreement of the Société en Commandite Spéciale, including the issue and subscription of all partnership units to the initial Limited Partner, and fixes the registered office of the SCSp at [address], Luxembourg, without prejudice to applicable substance rules. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the incorporation filings with the Luxembourg Business Registers and the RESA publication are hereby authorised and entrusted to the duly appointed authorised signatories. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed Gérant for day-to-day management, and [Name] is appointed AML compliance officer, each with powers set out in the Partnership Agreement, and that the opening of a bank account with a Luxembourg credit institution is hereby authorised.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Limited Partnership Agreement and KYC pre-clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg notary (only if real property is contributed) or private deed executed by the partners; no pre-filing governmental approval.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and execute the LPA identifying at least one general partner and one limited partner; use qualified electronic signatures or LuxTrust certificates for e-filing compatibility; complete the AML/KYC file for each partner and beneficial owner in preparation for RCS and bank onboarding.
required_dossiers: Notarial deed if in-kind real-estate contribution is made
Power of attorney for filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any signature or translation deficiency is cured by re-execution before submission; no governmental appeal is required at this pre-filing stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic registration of the SCSp with the Luxembourg Business Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RCS — Luxembourg Business Registers via the e-RCS/eJustice portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the registration application (immatriculation) with the executed LPA attached; pay the registration fee; the RCS will issue the registration certificate and the national business identification number (matricule/numéro national).
required_dossiers: Proof of Luxembourg registered office (lease or domiciliation agreement)
Identity documents of the General Partner and all Limited Partners
Certificate of existence/RCS extract if a partner is a legal entity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RCS issues a query, submit the missing document through the e-RCS portal within 15 calendar days; if the registration is refused, lodge an appeal with the Luxembourg District Court (Tribunal d'arrondissement) within one month of notification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RESA publication and entry into force against third parties
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers — RESA (Recueil Électronique des Sociétés et Associations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, the RCS automatically transmits the formation particulars to the RESA; verify the online publication and record the publication date, as the filing becomes opposable to third parties as of that date.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request a correction of publication errors via the LBR helpdesk; a corrected re-publication fee may apply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax, VAT, and social security identification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AED); Administration des contributions directes (ACD); Centre Commun de la Sécurité Sociale (CCSS) if staff hired
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the VAT number from the AED (mandatory if taxable supplies are made in Luxembourg; the SCSp is generally fiscally transparent for income tax purposes); procure the corporate income tax and municipal business tax identifiers from the ACD; file the beneficial ownership register (RBE) with the RCS in accordance with the amended law of 13 January 2019.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the AED or ACD queries the file, provide a reconciliation of the partnership structure within one month; any refusal of a VAT number based on the absence of taxable activity must be confirmed in writing and kept in the tax file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank account opening and activation of trade payment rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Luxembourg credit institution subject to CSSF AML/CFT supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the RCS certificate, RBE extract, LPA and the General Partner's resolution to the bank; complete the institutional KYC onboarding; activate SWIFT LC and TT/Wire payment rails for trade settlement.
required_dossiers: General Partner resolution approving bank account
KYC packs of general partner, limited partners and beneficial owners
Business plan and expected transaction volume statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If onboarding is refused, submit a reinforced KYC pack or apply to a second Luxembourg credit institution; file a complaint with the CSSF only after exhausting internal banking remedies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Substance set-up, domiciliation, and pre-licensing notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Certified Luxembourg domiciliation agent and the Ministry of the Economy (industry directorate)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conclude the domiciliation contract for the registered office; ensure core partnership decisions are taken in Luxembourg; notify the Ministry of the Economy of the intended classified industrial establishment before the construction or fit-out phase so that the operating permit procedure can be planned in parallel.
required_dossiers: Substance documentation (meeting minutes template, accounts segregation plan)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the domiciliation agent declines, appoint another authorised agent; if the Ministry of the Economy requests supplementary industrial data, respond within the specified deadline and adjust the pre-notification accordingly.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministère de l'Économie — Direction générale de l'industrie, de la recherche et de l'innovation, with the Administration de l'Environnement (Ministry of the Environment, Climate and Sustainable Development) and the competent commune (municipality) for land-use and operating permits.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Autorisation d'exploitation d'un établissement classé (Classified Establishment Operating Permit) under the amended Luxembourg Law of 21 March 2017 relative aux établissements classés, plus the radiation-protection clearance for X-ray test equipment under applicable radioprotection legislation transposing Directive 2013/59/Euratom. The permit names the General Partner as the establishment operator because the SCSp has no legal personality. CsI (stable isotope Cs-133) is non-radioactive; however, X-ray generators used for detector testing trigger the radiation-protection licensing regime.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Classified establishment requiring prior authorisation (class 1) under the Law of 21 March 2017; a full EIA is required only when the project meets the thresholds of the Law of 15 May 2018 on environmental impact assessment; medium-capacity clean-room/vapor-deposition lines will typically be subject to a simplified environmental compliance review and site-specific permit conditions.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: compliance with the Grand-Ducal Regulation of 16 November 1992 on wastewater discharge (pH 6.5–9, COD ≤125 mg/l, heavy metals such as As, Pb, Cd, Ni below agreed limit values) and municipal pre-treatment bylaws; air/VOC: solvent management, containment, and abatement thresholds per Directive 2010/75/EU (Industrial Emissions Directive) as transposed in Luxembourg; waste: hazardous waste (vacuum pump oils, isopropyl/acetone residues, CsI scintillator deposition waste) must be classified, stored on sealed bunded areas, and disposed of by a licensed waste operator under the Administration de l'Environnement waste tracking system.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: CGDIS (Grand-Ducal Fire and Rescue Corps) fire-safety certificate and emergency response clearance; structural load and electrical safety inspection by an approved contrôleur agréé; occupational health and safety clearance from the Inspection du Travail et des Mines (ITM), including radiation protection zoning, personal dosimetry, and X-ray shielding verification for the DR detector test benches.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Luxembourg Inland Revenue – Administration des contributions directes (ACD); indirect taxes: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT); online portals: MyGuichet.lu and eCDF (échange de données informatisé).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Luxembourg SCSp, the initial statutory registration is effected before the Registre de commerce et des sociétés (RCS) via MyGuichet.lu, providing the entity with an RCS number (13-digit / incorporation register number) which serves as the corporate reference. For VAT purposes, a VAT identification number is requested from the AEDT using the national registration form (n° 750) once the SCSp begins taxable transactions or reaches the taxable threshold. As an SCSp is fiscally transparent, direct income tax identification is not issued to the entity; partners with Luxembourg-source income obtain individual TINs from the ACD. Non-resident partners may apply for a Luxembourg income tax identification number where they are subject to Luxembourg withholding or assessment obligations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election is available under ordinary Luxembourg law; SCSp status is statutorily defined as fiscally transparent. The terms of the partnership agreement nevertheless determine the partners' allocation of taxable income, and the partners may invoke the ATAD anti-hybrid rules to reclassify a foreign 'reverse hybrid' double non-taxation event. A written election can be made to treat the SCSp as an opaque entity only where the partnership qualifies as a taxable subject under Luxembourg corporate tax law (factual/substantive test) – e.g., for VAT invoicing or for state-mandated tax returns.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT – Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 35,000 annual taxable turnover under the small business exemption; mandatory registration without threshold for importers, intra-EU acquirers exceeding the EUR 10,000 distance-sale threshold, and taxable persons performing reverse-charge transactions.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Luxembourg mandates electronic invoicing for B2G contracts via the PEPPOL network; there is no general B2B e-invoicing or real-time fiscal clearance regime, and no digital stamping requirement. Taxpayers must store all invoices for 10 years and use the electronic filing platform for VAT returns. For exported goods, an electronic customs declaration (Export Summary Declaration) is filed through the customs clearance system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Supplies of goods physically removed from the territory of Luxembourg to a destination outside the EU qualify for zero-rating (0% VAT), provided the goods are dispatched/transported by the exporter or on behalf of the exporter within 90 days of the supply and proof of export is obtained. Associated services to exported goods may also be zero-rated where they are directly linked to the export. The taxpayer must hold evidence of transfer of ownership and the transport out of the EU, for example via the customs export declaration and transport documents.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Exit Summary Declaration) with movement reference number (MRN)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill proving exit from the EU
Inward Remittance Certificate (or SWIFT/TT wire confirmation) evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
Proof of delivery / customs clearance at the destination country
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Luxembourg VAT administration audits export documentation within the standard 3-year (up to 5-year in case of fraud) assessment window. If the documentary burden of proof is not satisfied, the zero rating is reversed and VAT is assessed at 17% on the net sale price, plus default interest of 0.6% per month (or the applicable legal rate) and possible penalties. Material misrepresentation or fraudulent export claims trigger clawback of any refund, administrative fines up to 100% of the evaded tax, and criminal sanctions including imprisonment (in serious cases up to 5 years), in accordance with the Luxembourg General Tax Law (Abgabenordnung).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque Centrale du Luxembourg (BCL); prudential supervision and AML/CFT oversight vest in the Commission de Surveillance du Secteur Financier (CSSF) under the Law of 5 April 1993 on the financial sector and the Law of 12 November 2004 on the fight against money laundering and terrorist financing (as amended through the Law of 25 March 2020 transposing the 4th and 5th EU AML Directives). The BCL operates the Luxembourg component of TARGET2 and collects balance-of-payments statistics from resident credit institutions.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility for both current and capital account transactions. As a euro-area member state, Luxembourg applies Articles 63–65 TFEU and Directive 88/361/EEC guaranteeing unrestricted movement of capital between member states and with most third countries. The SCSp may freely invoice in EUR, USD, or other convertible currencies; there are no BCL approval procedures, pool requirements, parallel-market restrictions, or prior licensing steps for inward equity, shareholder loans, trade payments, or outward profit distributions. The only practical profit-remittance frictions are tax-driven (e.g., 15% Luxembourg withholding tax on dividends unless treaty-reduced; the SCSp is pass-through so distributions by the partnership to non-resident partners are generally outside that WHT net, but partner-level taxation in their residence state applies) and bank-level EDD reviews of source-of-funds documentation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable. Luxembourg imposes no statutory surrender rule, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation deadline on export proceeds from the sale of digital X-ray flat panel detectors (ISIC 3250). Receipts in EUR, USD, or other freely usable currencies may be retained, swept, or converted at corporate discretion. The only associated obligations are aggregate reporting of the entity's external financial position to the BCL (via the resident reporting bank) and the general AML transaction-monitoring duty under the Law of 12 November 2004.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.managed_currency_policy_notes: The euro floats freely; no crawling bands, no administered mid-rate, and no export-incentive conversion program apply to a Luxembourg SCSp. The BCL does not issue FX control circulars requiring transaction-level approval; traders should nonetheless ensure accurate balance-of-payments purpose codes to avoid bank-side operational holds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (EUR/USD multi-currency) and Capital Escrow Account for SCSp capital commitments
Operational Account and Capital Escrow Account for partnership drawdowns
Operational Account with export documentary letters of credit desk and trade reconciliation module
Operational Account and Escrow Account for the SCSp forming vehicle
Treasury cash concentration, FX swap execution, and USD CHIPS-clearing account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low–Medium feasibility. Luxembourg-authorized payment institutions and electronic money institutions (EMIs) licensed by the CSSF under the Law of 11 November 2021 (payment services, PSD2) and the Law of 21 December 2009 (electronic money) may provide virtual IBAN accounts to an SCSp, but EMIs cannot issue documentary credits (UCP 600), lack correspondent access to CHIPS/Fedwire for high-value USD trade settlements, and typically apply sub-EUR 250,000 daily turnover caps. Offshore digital EMIs without an EU passport are effectively blocked for a Luxembourg SCSp because the resident bank, the CSSF, and the UBO register requirements create a substance/traceability barrier; they are viable only as contingency disbursement rails for low-value service payments, never for the primary OEM trade cash flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote opening is legally permissible for CSSF-supervised banks under enhanced due diligence (video KYC with biometric liveness plus notarized copies), and the EU's AMLD5 framework supports remote customer due diligence under Article 13. However, in practice, most tier-1 Luxembourg banks require at least one physical interview with the general partner (gérant) or an authorized signatory of the SCSp; some also demand that the beneficial owners of the partnership be identified in the physical meeting either in Luxembourg, at the bank's Paris/Brussels/Frankfurt office, or at a notary. Physical presence compresses onboarding from 10–12 weeks to 3–4 weeks and materially reduces refusal risk. A representative with power of attorney may substitute for the general partner if appointed by notarial deed, but the bank will retain a discretionary right to re-interview the UBO.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The SCSp has no legal personality; the account is requested in the partnership's name but the general partner acts as the contracting party, creating doubt over who bears liability and control.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the SCSp partnership agreement (Law of 10 August 1915, as amended by the Law of 12 July 2013); RCS Luxembourg registration excerpt with partnership registration number; general partner's corporate/individual KYC pack; notarized mandate confirming the SCSp's opening of the account and the gérant's signature powers; external Luxembourg legal opinion on the SCSp's legal personality status and on the binding effect of the partnership's contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO chain opacity: limited partners, corporate nominees, or a multi-layered holding structure obscuring the final 25%+ owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully updated UBO register filing under the Law of 13 January 2019; organizational chart with identical shareholding percentages >25%; capital commitment schedule signed by each limited partner; passport/EU-ID copies of ultimate natural persons; external legal opinion confirming no undisclosed control or nominee arrangements; sworn statement from each 25%+ shareholder listing source of wealth for the injected capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent transaction profile: substantial inbound USD wire transfers from a foreign radiology OEM parent with no visible Luxembourg substance, payroll, or warehousing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial and tax substance file: sublease agreement for Luxembourg premises, CE-marking certificate under EU MDR 2017/745 for the digital X-ray flat panel detectors, signed purchase orders and Incoterms (e.g., FCA Luxembourg / CIP), customs export declarations, logistics contracts, social security filings for employees, DTT-residence certificate, auditor's confirmation of the entity's economic purpose, and the CSSF registration confirmation of the entity's AML compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP/sanctions hit on an officer or UBO, or on a limited partner domiciled in a restricted/high-risk jurisdiction.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated screening report with per-name resolution narration and timestamp; authoritative identity documents (EU national ID or biometric passport); independent EU legal opinion confirming non-applicability of targeted restrictive measures; sworn declaration disclaiming ties to sanctioned sectors; if applicable, a waiver or confirmatory clearance from the Luxembourg Ministry of Finance or the European Commission's competent authority, plus a bank-specific EDD questionnaire completed by the UBO.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route inward equity or shareholder-loan injections via SWIFT MT103 (or SEPA CT for EUR postings) to the SCSp account held with the chosen tier-1 bank. The bank must state the following purpose codes to satisfy BCL balance-of-payments reporting (ITRS): for equity capital contribution use 'Direct Investment – Equity (E1)'; for shareholder loan use 'Direct Investment – Intercompany Loan (L1)'; for trade pre-payment from a customer use 'Merchandise Trade – Goods (G1)' with invoice and ISIC 3250 contract reference. Verification protocol: the general partner's signed drawdown notice, the capital commitment schedule, board resolution (or equivalent partner resolution) authorizing the capital call, and a fully completed payment instruction page naming the SCSp's legal name, LU BIC, and its IBAN. For USD inbound wires, the bank will credit via the correspondent (CHIPS/Fedwire); no BCL FX approval is required. All postings are automatically mirrored to the BCL balance-of-payments collection system through the resident bank's reporting obligation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For supplier settlements of components (amorphous silicon sensors, cesium iodide scintillators) use SWIFT MT103 (field 50K originator, 59 beneficiary, field 70 with invoice/PO references) or SEPA Credit Transfer for EEA payees via TARGET2/SEPA rails at zero to near-zero fees. For OEM export sales of the digital X-ray flat panel detectors to North American/EU medical imaging integrators, use either USD SWIFT wires (direct-clearing corridor through the bank's CHIPS membership) or commercial documentary letters of credit issued under UCP 600 through the trade desks at BGL/BIL/Société Générale, with sight draft or 60–90 day usance tenor and Incoterms 2020 (FCA Luxembourg or CIP destination). All outgoing wires must carry an appropriate BOP purpose code (e.g., 'G1' for component imports, 'S' for services) to avoid reconciliation holds. The bank balances the SCSp's FX conversion needs by netting USD incomings against EUR supplier disbursements; where netting is insufficient, a spot EUR/USD transaction (value spot or tom-next) is executed on the internal dealing desk.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD forwards (maturity up to 12 months) executed under the ISDA master agreement or a local master confirmation; no BCL authorization required.
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD) with mutual posted collateral, MTM and CSA documentation held at a Luxembourg-licensed credit institution.
Plain vanilla EUR/USD options and zero-cost collars with CSSF-licensed counterparties where the SCSp sells covered OTM calls and buys protective puts.
FX swaps for temporary liquidity smoothing between the EUR operational account and the USD treasury pool.

Note on NDFs: NDFs are not required and are structurally non-permissible for the fully convertible EUR/USD pair; they are admissible only as an exceptional hedge for a third-currency exposure where the IN-US conversion is restricted (e.g., invoicing in a non-deliverable Asian currency), and only if the bank holds a dedicated credit line and the instrument is booked with a positive ISDA schedule.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.operational_liquidity_clearing_calendar: Monthly cycle: D-5 USD receivable forecast from OEM purchase orders; D-3 sweep of USD concentration into the treasury account; D-1 reconciliation of inbound wires against BOP purpose codes; D-0 netting/spot FX execution and execution of outbound SEPA/MT103 supplier payments; D+1 monitoring of value-date matches and exception handling for LC discrepancies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual RCS declaration (déclaration annuelle) confirming the registered corporate particulars of the SCSp
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers (LBR) - Registre de Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within one month following the anniversary of the RCS inscription date; where the SCSp is subject to annual accounts filing, the declaration is lodged within one month after approval of the accounts, in practice by 31 July for a 31 December financial year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-imposed fines from EUR 50 to EUR 5,000 against the general partner for failure to file or maintain accurate RCS data; repeated default triggers formal notice and commercial court strike-off (radiation) of the RCS file

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO register confirmation (certification annuelle des bénéficiaires effectifs) certifying that the recorded beneficial ownership data remains accurate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE), operated by Luxembourg Business Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the anniversary of the initial UBO registration, and without delay upon any transfer of partnership interests or change in beneficial ownership chain (Law of 13 January 2019, as amended)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines from EUR 1,250 to EUR 250,000 per infraction; criminal sanctions for knowingly false declarations; repeated non-compliance exposes the SCSp to judicial enforcement measures and related RCS strike-off proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT return (déclaration annuelle de TVA) together with the EC Sales List (état récapitulatif) for intra-Community B2B supplies of digital X-ray flat-panel detectors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Administration de l'enregistrement, des domaines et de la TVA (AEDT)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 15 April following the tax period for entities on the annual VAT filing scheme; monthly or quarterly returns continue to be due throughout the year for substantial cross-border supply activity
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment surcharge of 10% on undertaxed VAT amounts, interest accruing at 0.9% per month, and administrative fines up to EUR 2,500 for failure to file the annual return or EC Sales List

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (comptes annuels) publication - required only for an SCSp qualifying as a large enterprise ('grande entreprise')
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Luxembourg Business Registers - RCS (annual accounts deposit and publication)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Financial statements must be approved within six months of the financial year-end (by 30 June for a calendar year) and filed with the RCS for publication within one month after approval; non-large SCSp are exempt from filing and publication
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to EUR 5,000 for failure to publish, court-ordered filing upon third-party request, and strike-off (radiation) proceedings for persistent default; the business registers may additionally publish a notice of non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory statutory audit applies to a standard pass-through SCSp at entity level; an independent audit by an approved réviseur d'entreprises becomes compulsory only when the SCSp qualifies as a large enterprise by exceeding any two of three thresholds - balance sheet total EUR 4.4 million, net turnover EUR 8.8 million, average workforce of 50 employees - or when the partnership agreement, a founding partner, or the consolidated reporting requirements of a parent undertaking expressly impose an audit
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Luxembourg GAAP (plan comptable normalisé luxembourgeois) pursuant to the Law of 10 August 1915 on commercial companies, as amended, and the Law of 19 December 2008; IFRS as adopted by the European Union is optionally applied for voluntary statutory or consolidated financial statements

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Partnership interests in an SCSp are freely transferable by contractual agreement; the general partner must declare any transfer or change in the direct or indirect control chain (25% or more ownership) to the RBE within one month of the event and must certify annually, within one month of the UBO registration anniversary, that the recorded beneficial ownership data remains accurate; any continuing omission is treated as a fresh infraction
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Partners (movements of partnership interests and capital contribution records kept by the general partner)
Minute Book (general partner resolutions and partner decisions recorded for governance and audit trail)
Accounting Books and Supporting Records (commercial ledgers, sales/purchase invoices, inventory records positioned at the registered office address declared to the RCS)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 2,400 - USD 9,600 (EUR 2,000 - EUR 8,000) per year for a Luxembourg professional domiciliation agent covering SCSp registered office, KYC/AML, corporate secretarial and bank-facing administrative coordination
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 7,200 - USD 24,000 (EUR 6,000 - EUR 20,000) per engagement for a voluntary or mandatory statutory audit of a mid-size operating SCSp in the medical-device OEM sector

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 24.94% (Luxembourg City standard combined rate: 17% corporate income tax, 7% solidarity surcharge, and municipal business tax)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays. Available incentives include the Luxembourg participation exemption on qualifying dividends and capital gains, the IP box exempting 80% of qualifying IP income, R&D tax credits, and notional interest deduction for qualifying new equity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 600 (annual collective income tax and net wealth tax return) filed electronically via MyGuichet.lu / Guichet.lu; VAT and withholding returns are filed separately through the Luxembourg e-filing portals.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than 30 June of the year following the tax period for a standard 31 December year-end; the Luxembourg tax administration routinely grants an extension to 31 December upon timely request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, registered office, Luxembourg trade and companies register (RCSL) number, and tax identification number (matricule) of the SCSp.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SCSp is fiscally transparent; identify each partner, with non-resident partners clearly marked. No Luxembourg CIT account is required unless a partner has a Luxembourg permanent establishment or the entity is otherwise subject to a Luxembourg filing duty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate receipts, deductible expenses, net income, and the contractual profit allocation ratio among partners.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not convert the SCSp's net income into a taxable Luxembourg corporate base for non-resident partners unless the income is attributable to a Luxembourg permanent establishment; attach the allocation schedule and identify each partner's share.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Adjust book income for non-deductible items, exempt participating income, IP-box relief, and other tax incentives.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident partners should rely on tax treaty provisions; if a Luxembourg permanent establishment exists, allocate only the PE-attributable income to Luxembourg and claim foreign tax credit relief in the residence state.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declare the relevant net wealth base and any exempt qualifying participations held by the entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a transparent SCSp, net wealth tax exposure generally falls on the partners; unavailable to non-resident partners unless they have a Luxembourg permanent establishment and should claim treaty protection.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Controlled transactions, intercompany financing, royalty flows, and transfer pricing adjustments relating to the digital X-ray flat panel business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain OECD-compliant documentation locally; Luxembourg may request the Master File and Local File even where no CbCR filing threshold is met.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing exposes the taxpayer to administrative fines generally up to EUR 2,500, potential daily surcharges for continued default, and mandatory tax assessment on a discretionary basis. Late payment of assessed taxes attracts interest at 0.6% per month (7.2% per annum); intentional failure may escalate to criminal tax fraud prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% domestic Luxembourg withholding tax on dividends paid by a Luxembourg resident fully taxable company. A fiscally transparent SCSp is generally outside the dividend withholding tax net because profit allocations are taxed at partner level.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The taxpayer must file a Luxembourg tax residence certificate request with the Administration des Contributions Directes via MyGuichet.lu, submit the certificate to the Luxembourg paying agent, and complete the standard reduced/zero-rate withholding application before payment, or claim a refund after payment. Beneficial ownership and economic substance must be demonstrated.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Luxembourg withholding tax on outbound interest and royalties is 0%. For EU/EEA related parties, the EU Interest & Royalties Directive provides an additional 0% safeguard. DTA provisions apply only where a payment is recharacterized as a constructive dividend or deemed profit distribution.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 750,000,000 in consolidated group revenue triggers mandatory Country-by-Country reporting. Luxembourg does not set a statutory EUR threshold for Master File/Local File, but the tax administration expects OECD-aligned local and master file documentation to be available on request for all controlled transactions.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Luxembourg has no UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations, but EU ATAD, the Luxembourg General Anti-Abuse Rule, and substance-over-form doctrines apply. The SCSp must have real economic activity, actual management, premises, staff, and decision-making capacity in Luxembourg to preserve treaty benefits and resist recharacterisation as a letterbox entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly omitting or underreporting the share of SCSp income attributable to Luxembourg taxable partners; submitting a false Form 600; using artificial structures to divert income from the digital X-ray detector business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax reassessment with penalties of 10% to 20% of evaded tax; monthly late-payment interest at 0.6%; criminal prosecution with fines up to EUR 250,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and managing partners may be jointly and severally liable for evaded tax where they signed false filings or caused the default; courts may impose asset freezes, travel bans, and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an SCSp as a letterbox: no actual office, no personnel, no board or partner meetings held in Luxembourg, no business records, and no commercial activity related to the ISIC 3250 manufacturing scope, while claiming Luxembourg treaty or pass-through benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation of transactions; refusal of treaty benefits and participation exemptions; reassessment with penalties and interest; possible disqualification of the tax transparent status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil may be pierced so that directors and shareholders are treated as beneficial owners; civil restitution, director disqualification, and travel bans may be ordered.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting undeclared or anonymous partner contributions, failing to perform customer due diligence, or failing to report suspicious wire transfers and LC payments involving the X-ray panel OEM sales channel.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Luxembourg anti-money laundering law, money laundering is punishable by imprisonment up to 5 years and/or fines up to EUR 1,250,000; administrative sanctions may reach EUR 5 million or 10% of annual turnover for serious compliance failures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally exposed to criminal prosecution and administrative fines; regulators may impose bans on holding management functions and travel restrictions in cross-border investigations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Persistent non-filing of Form 600, destruction or concealment of accounting records for the statutory retention period, failure to file transfer pricing documentation upon notice, or obstructing a Luxembourg tax audit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Mandatory ex officio assessment, late-filing fine up to EUR 2,500, monthly late-payment interest, and a 10% to 20% surcharge; when combined with fraudulent conduct, criminal sanctions apply.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managing partners and directors may be held civilly liable for the unpaid tax and penalties; courts may impose director disqualification, travel bans, and detention in egregious cases.
